channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Nvidia was his dream job. An international student facing a visa deadline shares how he landed it.
item.description: Nvidia was his dream job, but he got turned down. So this 30-year-old regrouped and strategized. He shares how he got a job offer there.

item.title: Anderson Cooper is leaving CBS's '60 Minutes' after nearly 2 decades
item.description: Cooper, who has been working for both CNN and CBS, said he was quitting "60 Minutes" to spend more time with his children.

item.title: Epstein files: A list of people facing consequences over the DOJ's release
item.description: Goldman Sachs' Kathy Ruemmler, Paul Weiss's Brad Karp, and Prince Andrew's ex-wife Sarah Ferguson are just some of the people dealing with headaches.

item.title: An airline barred 2 passengers after an in-flight brawl and plans to go after them for the cost of diverting the plane
item.description: Diversions aren't cheap; they can cost airlines tens of thousands in fuel, labor, and airport fees. Any hotel and transportation costs also add up.

item.title: Salesforce cofounder 'not OK' with Benioff's ICE crack: 'Marc made a very bad joke.'
item.description: Salesforce CTO Parker Harris addressed Benioff's ICE controversy during an internal meeting.

item.title: After 3 years of forcing myself to love venture capital, I quit and became a silent disco DJ in Bali
item.description: Even though he realized right away, it took TK three years to quit what he thought was his dream career since college.

item.title: We tried a fiber-filled Diet Coke that could be sold in the US. It wasn't for everyone, but it won some fans.
item.description: 2026 is the year of fibermaxxing. So we tested Coca-Cola's fiber-enriched Diet Coke, a drink available only in Asia.

item.title: A Ukrainian drone pilot found a hidden Russian arsenal, only to discover it was filled with horses and old cars
item.description: Cosmos, a fiber-optic drone pilot, told Business Insider he was hunting for hidden Russian storages when he found the Ladas and two horses.

item.title: Welcome to Singapore's hustle economy
item.description: 20-hour kitchen days. Tears and budget fears. Lying flat is the last thing on these young Singaporean business owners' minds.

item.title: The EU's privacy watchdog is investigating X over sexualized AI images
item.description: Ireland's Data Protection Commission said it is investigating X over the generation of sexualized images of people in the EU, including minors.
